data.gender_notes: Hopeful is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word elpis, meaning 'expectation' or 'hope'. In Christian tradition, Hope is one of the Theological Virtues and represents trust and confidence in God's promises. The name Hopeful carries the meaning “Filled with hope” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hopeful usually hope their child will grow to embody filled with hope and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hopeful total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: קיווי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם 'קיווי' מקורו במילה העברית 'קווה', שפירושה תקווה או ציפייה. בהקשר הנוצרי, השם מייצג את התקווה המלאה באמונה בה' אלוקים ובישוע המשיח. השם קיווי משקף את האמונה כי האדם הוא בן אלוהים ויש לו תקווה לעתיד טוב יותר.

in_greek.name: Ελπιδοφόρος
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα 'Ελπιδοφόρος' προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'ελπίς' που σημαίνει ελπίδα και 'φόρος' που σημαίνει αυτός που φέρνει. Στο χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, το όνομα αντιπροσωπεύει εκείνον που φέρνει ελπίδα και φωτισμό στους άλλους μέσω της πίστης στον Ιησού Χριστό.

in_latin.name: Spes
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen 'Spes' derivatur ex verbo latino 'speres', quod significat spem habere. In ecclesia primitiva christiana, nomen 'Spes' erat virtus theologica quae significabat spem in Deo Patre et Iesu Christo. Hoc nomen reflectit fidem et expectationem futurorum bonorum.

in_english.name: Hopeful
in_english.meaning: Full of hope and expectation in God
in_english.long_meaning: The name 'Hopeful' originates from the English word 'hope', which is derived from the Old English 'hopian', related to the Proto-Germanic '*hopon' and Proto-Indo-European '*kep-' meaning 'to grasp or desire'. In Christian tradition, 'Hopeful' represents one who has faith and expectation in a better future through Jesus Christ. The name signifies a person with a positive outlook, trusting in God's plan and promises.

In many Christian communities, it is a name given to children to encourage them to believe in a brighter future and to face challenges with strength and resilience.
data.spiritual_significance: In the eyes of the Christian faith, the name "Hopeful" symbolizes a person's deep and abiding trust and confidence in God's love and divine presence. It also represents the human spirit's capacity to persevere through hardships and to keep moving forward, believing in the power of redemption and the promise of a better future. Ultimately, "Hopeful" serves as a reminder to never lose faith and to remain steadfast in one's beliefs.
